book.ars_arcane_matrix.matrix_core.overv: The $(item)Arcane Matrix Core$() is an endgame Source generator crafted with an Enchanting Apparatus. Place it at the center of three mutually perpendicular 5 by 5 rings made from Source Gem Blocks.$(br2)It starts automatically while complete. Up to six Arcane Amplifiers can replace the axial vertices, adding 25% generation each.
book.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_mine.overv: The $(item)Arcane Mine$() converts Sourcestone and Source Gems into tagged ore blocks. Build complete 3, 5, 7, and 9-wide inverted-beacon layers above the core. An Arcane Amplifier may replace each layer center.$(br2)Hang ore blocks below completed layer corners for a whitelist, or below cardinal edge centers for a blacklist. Pale and dark-red beams show the active tuning.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.matrix_c: The Arcane Matrix Core is a Conduit-like Source generator. Six Arcane Amplifiers may occupy its axial vertices, adding 25% generation each.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_m: The Arcane Mine is a Source-powered inverted-beacon multiblock. Center-column amplifiers increase output; ore samples hung below completed layers provide GUI-free whitelist and blacklist tuning.
message.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_mine.st: The first Arcane Mine layer is incomplete.
message.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_mine.cr: Cross-dimensional Arcane Mine links are disabled.
message.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_mine.in: The Arcane Mine has reached its material-container limit.
message.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_mine.bi: All Arcane Mine container links cleared.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.matrix_core.info: Automatically generates Source while its three-ring multiblock structure is complete.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_mine_core.i: Consumes material points and Source to produce data-driven ores. Ore blocks hung below layer corners form a whitelist; ore blocks below the four cardinal edges form a blacklist.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_amplifier.i: A rare byproduct of a full four-layer Arcane Mine. Matrix vertices gain 25% generation each; Mine layer centers add one ordinary ore and increase Source and material costs by 50%. Amplifiers never multiply their own byproduct.
